questions.q: After processing, some of the frames are "off". The flight summary:
questions.fragment:
Log: CAM records 412, TRIG records 0
Memory card: 405 files
CAM1_FEEDBAK_PIN = -1
options: The camera missed 7 triggers and there is no feedback: CAM records only the trigger commands, so georeferencing by number is shifted by frames
CAM1_FEEDBAK_PIN = -1 makes the camera shoot exactly one frame late after the trigger
412 triggers with 405 files means the camera wrote RAW+JPEG into different folders
ODM dropped 7 frames as blurred, and that is why the map is assembled with an offset
questions.explain: Without shutter feedback ArduPilot writes only CAM, at the moment the trigger was sent, and no TRIG; missed shots do not show in the log, and matching by number slips.
